svg.title: A/B Continuity Atlas — James Muneoka
svg.desc: A dark, luminous multi-world atlas. James, the living human referent, is represented at the heart of the inquiry; writing, games, mathematics, the workstation, world data, and provenance form six colored regions with cyan and magenta inquiry paths, and dotted cross-domain comparisons. Visual connections invite investigation, not blanket claims of mathematical equivalence.
svg.text: ONE INQUIRY · DIFFERENT WORLDS · EVIDENCE KEPT WITH ITS SOURCE
